tasks.short: Liaise between recreation administrators and instructors

steps.what: Serve as liaison between recreation administrators and activity instructors

tasks.design: Keep liaison and clarification with the recreation worker through meetings, {EMAIL} and {CHAT}. Existing shared documents may support communication, but no separate reporting stage or automated negotiation is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Administrators and instructors can have different priorities and interpretations.
tasks.enabler_now: Communication software supports contact without settling disagreements or building trust.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising an unspoken constraint and securing a workable agreement.
tasks.human_edge: The worker can judge tone, clarify intent and negotiate a practical understanding.
tasks.altitude: Liaison responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of personal service workers
reach.task: Resolve an escalated disagreement about an activity arrangement

evidence.claim: Liaison requires contextual clarification and relationship work; existing communication channels do not by themselves establish new labour savings.

assumptions: Boundary is liaison, not separate meeting scheduling or daily action-list compilation.
Worker produces clarified expectations through s1; no machine-readable agreement or inferred priority is assumed.
Check native communication and reference facilities before custom code.
No new tool or maintained process is introduced, justifying zero upkeep.
unknowns: Local decision rights and recurring sources of disagreement
research_questions: Which liaison problems arise from unclear authority rather than missing information?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and upkeep=0 give zero saving. Both routine liaison and disagreements retain their time; no copying baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Capture facility-use requests and confirmed maintenance constraints
Compare requested use and maintenance intervals with existing bookings
Resolve schedule conflicts and agree facility priorities
Check and save the agreed maintenance and facility-use schedule

tasks.design: Configure resource calendars, maintenance blocks and conflict warnings in {CALENDAR}. The worker confirms every constraint, resolves priority disputes and checks the final schedule; configuration reduces interval comparison and repeated entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Facility-use and maintenance intervals are compared manually and changes re-entered.
tasks.enabler_now: Native resource calendars can detect overlaps and reuse agreed event details without selecting priorities.
tasks.still_hard: Negotiating disruption, allowing realistic setup time and deciding which use should move.
tasks.human_edge: The worker can explain a change and recognise a constraint omitted from a booking request.
tasks.altitude: Less mechanical schedule comparison; no new maintenance-release or cancellation authority.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of personal service workers
reach.task: Resolve a facility priority conflict beyond the worker's authority
reach.learn: Resource constraints, change permissions and escalation

evidence.claim: Native resource calendars can flag overlapping intervals and reuse event details; the proposed recreation saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is scheduling, not maintenance execution or the labour of facility users.

Worker in s1 confirms and captures resource ID, requested interval, duration, setup/cleanup buffers, maintenance exclusion interval, requester, allowed alternatives, source and confirmation date. Full 30 hours include contact and entry.

Maintenance colleague supplies the existing requirement through normal coordination; no new form-filling labour is transferred. Missing duration or access restrictions require manual clarification in retained s1/s3.
S2 compares only verified intervals and displays conflicts; it neither declares a facility safe nor overrides a maintenance block. Retained 10 hours cover comparison exceptions.
S4 captures final changes and checks the exact resulting schedule. Native calendar reuse is tested before custom code; existing conflict detection earns no saving.
unknowns: Current manual comparison effort and native resource-calendar features
Who may change maintenance blocks or cancel bookings
research_questions: Can configured resource calendars catch setup and maintenance overlaps while leaving priority decisions with authorised people?

already_counted.description: Source constraint confirmation and field capture

incremental.description: Maintain resource rules, buffers, access and exception handling

approvals.approved_version: Exact resource schedule with dates, intervals, buffers, maintenance blocks and agreed changes; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100 and R=30+10+30+9=79 give gross 21, less 3 upkeep yields net 18. High requires manual interval comparisons and repeated entry today; low assumes only 3 hours removed in a largely configured calendar, consumed by upkeep. Source confirmation and conflict negotiation retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Visit residents individually in their rooms

steps.what: Conduct individual in-room visits with residents

tasks.design: Keep individual visits with the recreation worker and resident. Authorised context in {DOCS} may support preparation, but a digital message or summary is not treated as equivalent personal contact.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work depends on presence, listening and the resident's response.
tasks.enabler_now: No digest capability demonstrates that software can remove this relational time.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising an unexpressed need and respecting the resident's wish to engage or decline.
tasks.human_edge: The worker can respond to mood and pace and offer appropriate personal attention.
tasks.altitude: Visit time and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Receive a concern needing care-team follow-up after a visit
reach.learn: Consent, objective descriptions and referral boundaries

evidence.claim: Individual resident visits are relational contact; no new labour saving is established by digital reference access.

assumptions: Boundary is the visit, not subsequent documentation or scheduling.
Worker and resident produce the understanding in s1; no machine-readable wellbeing score or recorded conversation is assumed.
Check native reference access before future custom work.
No new process or tool is introduced, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Resident communication needs and local support boundaries
research_questions: What helps residents feel heard during a visit, and what concerns require another professional?

already_counted.description: All resident contact and listening remain

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and upkeep=0 give zero net saving. Short and complex resident visits retain personal contact time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop individual goals from assessments within authorised scope

steps.what: Review individuals' assessments and clarify their preferences and limitations
Develop treatment goals for individuals within the worker's authorised scope

tasks.design: Keep assessment interpretation and individual goal development with the authorised worker using {DOCS} for reference. Clinical treatment goals require the locally qualified professional; this task model grants no diagnostic or treatment authority from an occupational label.
tasks.previous_blocker: Goals must reflect the person's assessment, preferences and the worker's actual competence.
tasks.enabler_now: Document tools can hold assessments but do not settle goal suitability or clinical scope.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing meaningful, realistic goals without misreading an assessment or overriding the person's wishes.
tasks.human_edge: The worker can discuss priorities, recognise uncertainty and seek qualified clinical input.
tasks.altitude: Goal-development time and local authority remain unchanged.

reach.role: exercise trainer and group fitness instructor
reach.task: Discuss an activity goal within agreed professional boundaries
reach.learn: Assessment interpretation limits and referral responsibilities

evidence.claim: Individual goal development requires assessment interpretation and professional boundaries; records software alone establishes no saving.

assumptions: Boundary ends at proposed goals; clinical authorisation and delivery remain separate existing responsibilities.
Assessments are existing authorised inputs, not generated by this design. Worker develops context in s1 before goals in s2; no structured suitability score is assumed.
Where local recreation staff lack clinical authority, they propose participation goals for the qualified care team rather than prescribe treatment.
Test native reference facilities before future custom work. No new tool or maintained process is introduced, justifying zero upkeep.
unknowns: Local role qualifications and clinical goal-authorisation requirements
research_questions: Which goals may the recreation worker propose locally, and which require a qualified clinician's decision?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and upkeep=0 give zero saving. Both straightforward and uncertain assessment-to-goal cases retain interpretation and discussion time; unmodelled clinical work is not claimed saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce mechanical schedule work while keeping liaison, resident contact and assessment-to-goal judgement with people.
reach: Give service supervisors explicit schedule conflicts and care colleagues clearly bounded goal proposals
role.ambitious_version: A recreation worker who can coordinate reliable facility schedules and give residents personal attention within clear professional boundaries.
